A domesticated '''massiff''' was owned by a [[Unidentified Tusken Raider tribe|tribe]] of [[Tusken Raider]]s on [[Tatooine]] in the time following the death of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]].<ref name="Chapter 1" />

==Biography==
[[File:TuskenBoyAndPet-BoBFCh1.png|thumb|left|300px|The massiff lays in the sand next to the Tusken child.]]
After the death of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba]] the [[Hutt]], [[Boba Fett]] escaped from the belly of the [[sarlacc]] in the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]]. A [[Unidentified Tusken Raider tribe|tribe]] of [[Tusken Raider]]s captured the former [[bounty hunter]] and took him to their camp. The [[massiff]] was tasked with guarding Fett and [[Unidentified Rodian prisoner|another prisoner]], who were tied to the stumps of two dead trees. During the night, Fett attempted to escape and in the process knocked the massiff out and used its teeth to cut the ropes restraining his wrists. The massiff regained consciousness and chased after the bounty hunter into the [[Dune Sea|desert]]. The [[reptile]] knocked Fett to the ground allowing him to be recaptured by the pursuing Tusken Raiders.<ref name="Chapter 1" />

The massiff later accompanied one of the tribe's [[Unidentified Tusken Raider youngling|younglings]] as he led Fett and the Rodian into the desert to dig up [[black melon]]s. In the process, they woke a [[sand beast]] buried beneath the sand. In defense of the youngling, the massiff attacked the creature and was subsequently struck and knocked unconscious. Boba Fett was able to kill the creature with the chain restraining his legs, and the massiff accompanied the child and Fett back to the Tusken camp with the severed head of the sand creature as a prize.<ref name="Chapter 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The massiff first appeared in "[[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land]]," the first episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]''.<ref name="Chapter 1" />
